description: Run on a PE primary to gracefully decommission a draining compiler's Intermediate CA (POST .../decommission). Performs no CRL step -- agent certificates it signed remain valid until they naturally renew. 409s if the ICA is not currently draining. Requires an RBAC token (certificate_authority:sign_ica) since this route has no certname allowance.

compiler_fqdn.description: Certname/FQDN of the compiler whose Intermediate CA to decommission.

token_file.description: Path to an RBAC token file granting certificate_authority:sign_ica. Defaults to ~/.puppetlabs/token (the file `puppet access login` writes).
